rules.description: Right Shift: tap alone = Escape, held = Shift (plain pass-through while right Command or left Option is held, so no Esc inside a layer)
kitty and Ghostty only: right Command + key = plain Alt+key for zellij (before the ALT rules)
Hyprland binds: left Option = SUPER, right Command = ALT (generated by generate.py; see AGENTS.md)
Left Command + Space = Raycast (sends its hotkey ⌃⌥⌘D, same as SUPER+D; Spotlight never sees it)
Left Command + h/j/k/l = arrow keys (Corne layer 1)
